messages:
akshay: Kicking off perf validation for ap-southeast-4 GPU bring-up. Goal: kernel+driver matrix, NVLink probe, p95/p99 tails, and end-to-end throughput for inference lanes. Quick volunteers? 

maria: On it. Can you drop the minimal checklist + exact commands? 

akshay: Short checklist:
1) Verify driver/kernel combo
2) Run nvlink sanity + topo
3) Run small batch of inference (1s seq) to get p95/p99
4) Soak with concurrent streams for 30m
5) Collect dmesg/iomem and profiling traces
Commands:
```bash
ssh gpu-node-01
nvidia-smi -L && nvidia-smi topo -m
sudo modinfo nvidia | grep -E 'version|depends'
sudo dmesg --ctime | tail -n 200
iperf3 -c perf-probe -P 8 -t 30
# inference smoke
python -m perf_runner --model=l50 --batch=1 --seq=1024 --qps=10 --duration=60
``` 
Ping me when results are in. :eyes:

peng: saw a kernel oops during driver roll last night on node-07, attached snippet below (first 3 lines):
```
[  342.123456] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31, PID=2345
[  342.123467] NVRM: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[  342.123480] Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception
```
If anyone hits repeat, stop the soak and escalate to eng-runtime.

ops-bot: deploy: kernel/driver update applied to cluster/ap-southeast-4 @1959876600 by akshay

maria: Ran the nvlink/topo checks on node-01..node-04. Topology looks healthy but observed asymmetric bandwidth between 01<->03 (nvlink reports 50GB/s vs expected 75GB/s). Ran iperf3 across the hosts, numbers:
- node-01 -> node-03: 9.6 Gbits/sec (8 streams)
- node-01 -> node-02: 24.8 Gbits/sec
So host NIC or switch lane might be limiting. Also kernel dmesg shows a few late PCIe link retrains (see pasted). 

sam: Confirming: hosts provisioned with 25Gb interfaces in this rack — vendor ordering mismatch vs spec (should be 100Gb). Cost flagged in provisioning ticket #INF-4321. We can either re-rack to 100Gb switches or plan model routing to avoid cross-rack hot paths. 

akshay: Thanks. For blocking items:
- If NICs are 25Gb, we have reduced throughput — fallback plan is to cap concurrent streams to avoid p95 blowouts and enable model-routing policy to local nodes.
- If repeated kernel oops occur, rollback driver to last stable and reopen a maintenance window.
Action items: @maria collect full iperf logs + dmesg for the 01-03 path and attach to INF-4321. @sam coordinate with hardware to confirm switch SKU and timeline. @peng hold on further kernel updates until eng-runtime ACKs. 

maria: Uploaded logs to INF-4321 and linked the perf graphs. p95 for inference smoke: 34ms (baseline expected 18-22ms), p99: 88ms. Soak will be extended 1h with reduced concurrency.

akshay: Handoff plan: if soak looks stable after the 1h reduced run, we'll mark validation ready for infra-handoff. If not, status -> 'requires-hardware' and schedule re-provision. Targeting a handoff slack note at 1959877600 UTC. :white_check_mark:

sam: Noted. I'll update procurement and cc infra-leads.

peng: copying eng-runtime in case kernel traces pop. Thanks.

akshay: Closing here for now — keep this thread for logs only. Ping me if the p99 increases by >2x. :rocket:
